title: hussain kashtie ummat ko thaamne waale
body:
hussain kashtie ummat ko thaamne waale
dare huzoor pe haazir hai maangne waale
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain bigde muqaddar sawaarne waale
hussain girte huo'n ko sambhaalne waale
hussain aayi balaao'n ko taalne waale
<<DIVIDER>>
hujoome fikr se ab dam labo pe aata hai
hussain aap ne laakho ka ghar banaaya hai
wafoore gham se andhera nazar me chaaya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ki tumko nabuwat ka waasta moula
Ali ki tumko imamat ka waasta moula
quda ki aapko azmat ka waasta moula
<<DIVIDER>>
jawaani-e ali akbar ka waasta aaqa
shahadate ali asghar ka waasta aaqa
sakina pyaasi ki furqat ka waasta aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhi mashiyate qaaliq ho aur kis se kahe'n
kahan talak ghamo andoh apne dil pe sahe'n
ba haqqe zainabo kulsoom bigde kaam bane
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhi to bigde muqaddar banaane waale ho
tumhi to qaide alam se chudaane waale ho
gule muraad se daaman ko bharne waale ho
<<DIVIDER>>
bohot hi qalb shikasta hai na-ummeedi se
hazaaro thokre khaai hai badnaseebi se
badalde'n aap muqaddar ko khush naseebi se
<<DIVIDER>>
*hijaab* aankho se rouza lagaane aati hai
hijaab ashke aqeedat chadaane aati hai
hijaab jaawera qismat banaane aati hai
